purpose: Test whether seeing more low-friction starts improves complete roll and roll-to-walk under unchanged acceptance criteria.

parent.equivalence: The same imported actor and frozen observation normalization and the same freshly initialized critic, Adam and exploration settings are in the packaged checkpoint. Both arms load it byte-for-byte before any transition; the author’s original optimizer history was not reconstructed.

only_candidate_change.candidate: same uniform draw, lower half maps to [0.7,0.85], upper half to [0.85,1.3]

common_training.parallel_environments_rule: Choose after the repeated CUDA net-throughput sweep and learner-capacity check, same count in both arms.
common_training.optimizer: fixed PPO configuration for both arms, five epochs and four minibatches
common_training.media: Recording starts at episode boundary, final sample before reset, complete episode every 180 seconds while possible, no extra physics.

admission.status: CUDA sampling scale measured; isolated PPO throughput and selected-scale learner reset-only checks pending
requires: Verify the same actor input and output, optimizer and value weights in the two arms before the first step.
Read back all parameters and actual sliding-mu on the chosen training scale. Enforce the 85% whole-device threshold.
Open and observe the actual status in VS Code before any physics or learning. Keep run ID, native status, logs, measured update throughput and complete clips.
Freeze source, learner checkpoints, output names and disjoint seed use before starting and preserve deterministic source-level comparison.

development_evaluation.candidate_admission: Reach the original roll and complete-route gates for both conditions and both development seeds, no safety regression, and at least four more rolling successes than the uniform learner per low-friction seed. Check nominal retention and predeclared fresh holdout before delivery.

capacity_profile.purpose: Measure full PPO net throughput in fresh processes; pilot weights are not used for selection.
capacity_profile.repeat_order: Run admitted sizes in both directions, one new isolated worker at a time.
capacity_profile.compare: Lower net throughput of larger size must exceed higher net throughput of current size by at least 3%; candidate shares final selected size.
sections: process CPU and whole GPU telemetry
capacity_profile.measurement_scope: Equal PPO budgets and phase counts at each size for throughput only; weights discarded from selection. Evaluation results rely on the later equal-sample pair.
